text:
tasha: quick huddle — need to decide which long-tail customer asks for Hosted API we fold into this quarter's OKRs. short notes, please.
leo: thanks. can we start with a concise list of asks you've collected? maybe rank by revenue impact + implementation effort.
anya: from CS: three recurring asks — 1) per-tenant rerank tuning controls, 2) lower-cost embedding tiers (quantized) for batch jobs, 3) deterministic responses option for compliance-heavy accounts.
sam: also a customer trial asking for streaming-by-chunk (they need partial results) — affects runtime more than API surface.
kevin: tradeoff callout: rerank tuning is high product value but needs eval infra for regression checks. embeddings tier is mainly infra + quantization work.
leo: what about SLA/latency impact? rerank tuning could increase tail latency if we let customers request larger beam sizes.
tasha: good. propose we bucket them: A) ship-safe (small infra lift + high value), B) needs gating (evals + infra), C) long runway. initial thought: embeddings-tier -> A, rerank controls -> B, deterministic-mode -> C.
anya: CS disagrees on deterministic-mode; at least one enterprise prospect expects it as an onboarding blocker. can we scope a "deterministic-lite" first pass? e.g., seed-based output stabilization with clear disclaimers.
sam: incremental approach ok. for streaming-by-chunk: runtime change but could be partially supported by introducing a chunked streaming API header and a backend flag. effort: medium.
product-bot: FYI — existing Hosted API backlog has 28 items tagged "customer-ask/hosted". 7 of them are embedding-related.
kevin: eval requirements for rerank: we need per-tenant test suites + signal collection. estimate 4 wks infra + 3 wks engineering.
leo: embeddings quant tier — estimate: quantize models (existing toolchain), add billing SKU, run perf tests. 3 wks infra + 2 wks engineering.
tasha: can we get a one-line OKR alignment statement for each candidate? e.g., embeddings-tier -> "Reduce unit embedding cost by 3x for batch workloads; increase adoption among analytics teams by N%".
ya: sure: embeddings-tier -> "Lower cost for large-scale embeddings to expand PLG trials"; rerank-controls -> "Improve conversion for search customers by enabling per-tenant scoring profiles"; streaming-chunk -> "Reduce perceived latency for interactive partners".
sam: risk notes: streaming-chunk may require more memory headroom for concurrency; we should include a canary and throttling policy.
kevin: rollout plan for rerank-controls: feature-flagged canary (5% customers) + automatic rollback if MRR impacting regression > 0.5%. need product instrumentation.
leo: on prioritization — if embeddings-tier moves to A, that frees QA cycles for rerank later. embeddings also has clearer cost-saving metric for Q-end reporting.
tasha: decision proposal: move embeddings-tier to sprint 1 (A), streaming-by-chunk to sprint 2 (A/B hybrid), rerank-controls gated—start infra planning this quarter (B). deterministic-mode deprioritized to backlog unless enterprise LOI appears.
anya: +1 from CS on that sequence. I'll flag the enterprise ask and keep them warm with "deterministic-lite" doc.
sam: action items: 1) kevin: draft infra plan for rerank-controls (due in 4d). 2) leo: scope quant pipeline + perf test (due in 3d). 3) tasha: write canary criteria for streaming-chunk (due in 2d). 4) anya: customer comms + intake doc for deterministic request (due in 1w).
kevin: noted.
leo: noted.
tasha: thanks — I'll convert this thread into a formal slice doc for the roadmap board. if anyone has objections to the sequencing, speak now.
anya: no objections. :thumbsup:
kevin: no objections.
sam: no objections.
product-bot: Reminder: please add "hosted" label to any created tickets so roadmap sync picks them up.
